text:
oncall-bot: [PAGER] SEV2: Post-deploy latency spike observed on runtime-prod (canary slice) — deploy id=2026-03-17-02. p95 token latency ↑ 3x, errors ≈ 5%

matt_runtime: ack, pulling logs + dashboards. canary hosts showing severe tail. linking grafana.

sre-jen: I'm seeing kernel selector fallbacks on a subset of hosts: "kernel_selector: fallback_to_generic=true" — compiled kernel mismatch suspicion.

carlo_ops: grabbing logs from host-42 and host-44. snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T10:46:12Z] runtime: kernel_select: nx_kernel_v2 failed -> fallback_generic
[2026-03-17T10:46:13Z] batcher: microbatch_delay=120ms, queue_len=0
[2026-03-17T10:46:14Z] kvcache: hotkey_shard=3 thrash=high
```

support-liz: customer impact: AlphaCorp (VIP) reported multiple timeouts and degraded UX. Ticket #2321. Affects ~2% of total traffic but violates their SLA clauses.

product-dan: decision point — flip runtime-scheduler feature flag off or roll back the deploy? What gives fastest relief?

matt_runtime: kill-switch flag first (less blast radius). rollback if flag flip not stabilizing.

sre-jen: I can flip `runtime_scheduler_v2` via FF service. Command I will run: `ffctl set runtime_scheduler_v2 false --env=prod --rollout=immediate`

pm-sasha: please keep me posted, I'll handle customer comms template if we need to escalate.

oncall-bot: action issued: ff change request queued by sre-jen at 4555557000

sre-jen: executed flag flip at 4555557001. Monitoring.

matt_runtime: after flag flip: p95 improved on 3/6 canary hosts within 90s. tail latency still has some jitter on older kernel path though.

carlo_ops: note: automated rollback didn't trigger earlier because throughput thresholds were within limits; the automated check looks at error rate + throughput, not tail latency — canary policy gap.

sre-jen: temporarily increasing canary capacity by +20% to blunt hotkey thrash while we observe. Command: `kubectl scale deploy/runtime-canary --replicas=6`

matt_runtime: alpha-corp support reports fewer timeouts after flag flip. p95 trending back toward baseline. I'll keep a 15m watch. Assigning follow-ups: matt_runtime -> kernel selector deep-dive, carlo_ops -> kv shard/heavy-hotkey analysis, pm-sasha -> customer comms & postmortem owner.

support-liz: sending brief to AlphaCorp: "We've applied a temporary configuration change to mitigate a performance regression introduced in today's deploy. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause and timeline."

product-dan: if we see recurrence within watch window, we escalate to full rollback: `./deploy rollback --release=2026-03-17-01 --env=prod --targets=canary`

sre-jen: adding timeline note to incident log. tagging eng-sre for postmortem.

oncall-bot: incident status -> mitigated (temporary flag off + scaling) — monitoring until 4555557299

matt_runtime: leaving this thread open while we watch; will update in 10m or on any regression. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

support-liz: standing by for any customer updates.

pm-sasha: will kick off postmortem template after stable. please dump relevant logs and kernel selector traces into the incident doc.

carlo_ops: captured KV shard trace and hotkey map, will paste into the postmortem doc.

sre-jen: prepping a short runbook addition: if kernel_selector falls back on >20% hosts post-deploy -> immediate flag flip + autoscale + page eng-sre.

matt_runtime: confirmed: p95 back within 1.2x baseline across canaries at 4555557240. closing watch at 4555557299 unless we see new alerts.

oncall-bot: incident closed to monitoring at 4555557299 — follow-ups assigned for postmortem and TTL 72h for RCA.
